svg.title: The Zeus QA feature factory line
svg.desc: boot, four Haiku scouts joined at one point, Sonnet mapper, Opus collector and keeper-dispatch. keeper-dispatch relaunches the detached scouts, and on BATCH_EMPTY sends the line to clock-idle, which waits five minutes and then starts a new intake at the scouts or, on TIME_UP, goes to final-report. Three worker lanes in git worktrees with reviewer, devil's advocate and verifier, ci-snapshot, judge, fix-gate that sends FIX to the fixers and back to review or ROUND_LIMIT to the gatekeeper after three rounds, xhigh gatekeeper that calls apply-migration.sh, notify (Telegram, now off), keeper-stamp, and a clock that loops to the scout join for the next cycle or on TIME_UP runs final-report, final-notify and ends.
